_about: Published Canadian geoscience data MMP can use for project assessment and drill targeting. `verified` says how each entry was established: 'source' means I read the agency's own page or licence document in this session; 'catalogue' means it comes from a third-party index and the agency's own terms have NOT been checked. Do not build a client-facing feature on a 'catalogue' entry without verifying its licence first.
_licence_warning: Commercial redistribution is the binding constraint for MMP Studio, not availability. An open portal does not imply a commercial-use licence, and 'no licence stated' is not permission.

sources.format: Geosoft binary .grd (DATA) and 3-band uint8 RGB GeoTIFF (RENDERED PICTURE ONLY)
sources.licence: NOT STATED on the download directory or its readme. The same host carries an end-use licence (https://gq.mines.gouv.qc.ca/documents/sigeom/Licence.pdf) restricting use to the licensee's own premises, forbidding transfer to third parties and requiring written MERN authorisation for any other use. A third-party catalogue claims CC BY 4.0 for SIGEOM; that licence is confirmed only for the Donnees Quebec vector datasets, not for these rasters.
sources.licence_status: UNRESOLVED - ask service.mines@mern.gouv.qc.ca in writing before shipping derived products
sources.notes: The GeoTIFF is a colour image, not values - checked: 3 bands, uint8, all 255 at the centre. Only the .grd carries nT. GDAL has no Geosoft driver; src/minemodelingpro/geosoft_grid.py reads it.
